degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Mathematics
details: Trustee Scholarship Recipient: I had the honor of being awarded the prestigious Trustee Scholarship, the highest-ranking scholarship for academic achievement. Due to my efforts, I was awarded this honor every semester until graduation. This recognition reflects my commitment to excellence in my studies.

Dean's List: Throughout my college tenure, I earned a place on the Dean's List every semester. This achievement highlights my dedication to maintaining high academic standards and achieving excellence in my coursework.

Research Assistant at Hope College: During the summer of 2012, I had the opportunity to contribute to the field of computer science as a Research Assistant in the Hope College Computer Science Department. My focus was on computer security education, where I immersed myself in testing and learning various security tools. Subsequently, I applied this knowledge to construct engaging lessons and labs, empowering others to delve into the world of computer security.
